answer: Each identity must keep a relic, an object from its earliest work. Honest relics are worn smooth; a farm's are polished yesterday. Every identity speaks in a cipher, a code grown from its own history. Honest ciphers differ; a farm's share one key, one shorthand. Trust blooms violet, a flower that only grows where soil has been tended. Honest violets bloom at different times; a farm's on the same day, in one row. To pass, a farm must carry a real relic, speak a real cipher, and grow a real violet for every sockpuppet.
